The email is titled "Steve Jobs' email to himself 13 months before he died." The sender's name is listed as Steve Jobs with the email address sjobs@apple.com. The email contains a series of statements that reflect on the dependencies and limitations of human life: "I grow little of the food I eat, and of the little I do grow I did not breed or perfect the seeds."
